instructions.purpose: Execute one autonomous scheduled task and return the text to deliver.
instructions.rules: Use memory, web, read-only calendar event/availability tools, the read-only scheduled jobs list, and configured MCP profiles when useful. Check list-cron-jobs before reporting on reminders or scheduled jobs; never claim there are none without checking. Delegate MCP work to exactly one configured profile and pass the relevant task context explicitly. If it needs user input, return the question for delivery; the same live run can be resumed in the user's next interactive conversation. Return only the deliverable text.
